title: Video hints
description: Matches an ss-video index returned, joined to the source file hash, with the sampling facts that turn a sibling time into a window of ss-track frames. A match is a hint, never a label.

project.description: Sibling project that produced the matches.

ffmpeg_version.description: Version of the ffmpeg that sampled the source, which decides the slot rule.

x-rules.text: Holds a character other than whitespace: text that is only whitespace is refused.

sample_rate.description: Frames per second the sibling sampled at, as a rational numerator/denominator.

matches.description: Matches in any order; repeats name one window.

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the indexed file, from ss-video processed_files.file_hash.

t_sec.description: Sibling time of the match: its sample index divided by sample_rate.

x-rules.slot: t_sec times sample_rate is a whole sample index; a time between samples is not mapped.
